title: 🍉 AI Topic Summary
notTopic:
Open a topic first
to use the AI summary
notTopicHint: Refreshes automatically once you open a topic
infoFailed: ❌ Failed to load topic info. Refresh the page and retry.
rangeHintSegmented: {count} posts on the site; long topics are summarized in segments
needConfig: ⚠️ Configure the API in Settings first
sourceDisclosure: Selected post content and author names/usernames are sent to your configured AI service. Follow-ups send the saved summary, included digests and recent conversation, plus selected original excerpts when enabled.
invalidRange: Enter a valid integer floor range

sources.label: Replies to summarize
sources.hint: Uses the forum's Popular replies across the topic, limited to your range. Popularity is not relevance or consensus; corrections and minority views may be omitted.
sources.unavailable: Popular replies are unavailable for this topic.
sources.prompt: Sources are only forum-selected popular replies in the requested range, not the whole discussion; state this scope. Popularity is not correctness or consensus; corrections and minority views may be missing.
sources.done: Complete: {count} forum-selected posts in floors {start}–{end}; other replies not summarized.

outputPlaceholder: Generate a summary to see it here.
noVisiblePosts: No posts in the selected range are visible to this account
partialPrefix: > Partial summary — final pass not completed
digestsPrefix: > Completed segment digests — final pass not completed
doneProgress: Summary complete · floors {start}–{end}, {count} posts read; expand to ask follow-ups
keepPartialSuffix: ; partial results kept — copy or retry
truncated: Output hit the length limit; received content was kept. Raise the output limit and retry.

settings.security: Data safety · Selected posts, author identities and follow-up context are sent to your configured AI service. The key stays in script-manager storage and is used for that service. History is local and separated by site/account; this is not encryption or protection from someone using the same browser profile. Use HTTPS for remote services; HTTP exposes content and keys in transit.
settings.urlHintPrefix: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions: use the root, /v1 base, or full /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Reverse-proxy paths and HTTP for local services are preserved.
settings.modelHint: Enter a model ID supported by your service. No model is selected automatically. Leave the key empty only if the service needs none.
settings.limitHint: Input budgets count characters, not tokens; model context must also fit the output limit and API overhead. Chat Completions requests use max_tokens. Thinking models may spend part of this allowance on reasoning. Check your service/model limits.
settings.continuationsHint: If an answer hits its output limit, request up to this many continuations and join them. Applies to each segment, final answer and chat. Each is a paid request; context plus partial text must fit the budget. Empty answers and network errors are not retried.
settings.bufferedLabel: Compatibility mode: show the result at once (no streaming)
settings.localHint: If a LAN service cannot be reached, check its bind address, firewall, userscript target-host permissions and browser local-network permission. HTTP is never upgraded to HTTPS. Enable buffered mode if streaming is unsupported. Test connection sends a real prompt and may incur charges; it uses the configured output allowance for all formats so reasoning models can return an answer. Increase the allowance if output is truncated; no paid request is automatically repeated.
settings.resetSectionDesc: Clear API configuration and custom prompts
settings.testing: Sending a fixed short text; post content is not included…
settings.testOk: Connected — the service returned valid content

toasts.invalidBudget: Input budget must be an integer 2000–48000 and output limit 256–8192

confirmReset:
Reset the configuration?
This clears the API configuration and custom prompts. History is kept.

history.storageHint: 💾 Stored locally for this site/account. Older unscoped history is preserved in script storage but hidden because its owner cannot be verified.
history.confirmClear:
Clear all history?
This cannot be undone.
history.legacyRecord: Legacy record (site and range not stored)

viewer.title: Summary detail
viewer.consultReplies: Consult original replies for this question
viewer.retrievalHint: Reads up to 200 saved floors; sends up to 6 keyword-matched excerpts and author names to your AI. Mention [第N楼] to target a floor. Partial search only.
viewer.retrievalUnavailable: Original replies require a saved range and a topic on this site.
viewer.retrieved: Read floors {start}–{end}; sent {count} excerpts: {floors}. Other replies may matter.
viewer.retrievalBudget: Not enough input budget for replies. Raise it in Settings.
viewer.noReplyEvidence: No accessible excerpts found; nothing was sent. Try a specific floor or turn off original replies.
viewer.unverifiedCitations: Citations outside the supplied evidence: {floors}. Unverified.
viewer.chatHintWithDigest: Answers use the summary and attached digests, not the original posts. Only recent complete exchanges that fit the budget are sent.
viewer.chatHintPlain: Answers use the summary, not the original posts. Only recent complete exchanges that fit the budget are sent.
viewer.budgetExceeded: Summary plus question exceeds the input budget. Raise the budget in settings or shorten the question.
